judge.notes:
I checked every statement in feat.classification.md against feat.prebacklog, feat.intake, org.routing_map (both the feature override and the org-level file), org.architecture and all 12 requirement files. A Glob shows the requirements/ directory holds exactly those 12, so the claim that every requirement file was compared is true.

Both refusal points from attempt 1 are fixed. The transform.to_model inference is gone. The statement "only CR-6 is customer-visible" is gone too; it now appears as non-blocking open question OQ-E, which says the inputs do not answer it.

What the sources support:
- Category: New Feature comes from expected_type in ZD-48600.md. Route "full" and the T2 risk note come from its front matter.
- Duplicate table: each row's type, repositories and facts match the requirement files. Examples: ZD-48470 is feed v2 with reason 'InvalidCurrency'. ZD-48600 is feed v3, and its column list has no currency column, which grounds OQ-B. PROV-ACME-2026-11 replaces acme-text-2 with acme-text-3 and adds a system field. ZD-48377 is the exactly-30-days defect landing in 31-60. REG-LPR-2026-4.2 sets Late at more than 60 days. RETRO-2026-19 says "Technical only: no customer-visible change".
- Impacted repositories line: present, matches the feature routing map, and correctly notes that the org-level map lists only ap_aging.
- Section 2: the CR-3 "no LLM" note and the CR-4 acme-llm/acme-text-2 dependency trace to feat.prebacklog (model dependency map).
- Section 4: the decision-log check (D-2026-031, D-2026-044, D-2026-050) restates the no-conflict finding in feat.prebacklog. The L-007 reference matches memory.
- No numbers or dates appear that are not in a source.

Minor points:
- Interpretive wording, not an invented fact: "CR-5 uses the same boundary" for ZD-48377. That defect's exactly-30-days boundary is bucket 1-30 versus 31-60, while CR-5 uses "> 30". Exactly 30 days is the boundary in both, so the claim holds.

Completeness gaps:
- The trigger says technical work should be a sub-category under each entry, classified as "Technical Only" where it applies. The output lists CR-1 to CR-7 as technical sub-categories with an area, repository and owner. It does not give a per-CR Technical Only yes/no, and it leaves visibility per CR open in OQ-E. This is defensible because no source settles which CRs are customer-visible, but it only partly meets the trigger.
- The Pre Backlog sheet and the DevOps board were not available. The output states this openly (OQ-F, carrying forward OQ-1).
- Nothing was merged. Each related item asks for a different function or view, so "duplicates merged" is satisfied by the explicit, sourced decision "No duplicates found. Nothing was merged." The related items get sequencing questions instead (OQ-A to OQ-D).
